name: through-pipeline
source: define add(value: Int, amount: Int) gives Int { give value + amount } define double(value: Int) gives Int { give value * 2 } show(5 through add(3) through double)

name: generic-number
source: define add<Value: Number>(left: Value, right: Value) gives Value { give left + right } show(add(20, 22))

name: generic-constraint-rejected
source: define add<Value: Number>(left: Value, right: Value) gives Value { give left + right } add("a", "b")

name: or-give-success
source: define source() gives Result<Int, String> { give ok(41) } define answer() gives Result<Int, String> { keep value = source() or give give ok(value + 1) } show(answer())

name: or-give-failure
source: define source() gives Result<Int, String> { give err("blocked") } define answer() gives Result<Int, String> { keep value = source() or give give ok(value + 1) } show(answer())

name: missing-needs
source: define load(path: String) gives Result<String, String> { give std.files.read(path) }

name: structured-together
source: define one() gives Int { give 1 } define two() gives Int { give 2 } keep joined = together [start one, start two] show(choose joined { Ok(values) => values[0] + values[1], Err(problem) => 0 })

name: bytes-and-persistent-map
source: keep data: Bytes = std.bytes.from_string("Nivren") keep map: Map<String, Int> = std.map.single("size", std.bytes.length(data)) show(std.map.get(map, "size") ?? 0)

name: json-value-roundtrip
source: keep parsed = std.json.parse("{\"edition\":3}") show(choose parsed { Ok(value) => std.json.stringify(value), Err(problem) => err(problem) })

name: shape-derived-json
source: choice Role { Admin, Member } shape User { name: String, role: Role, score: U8 } keep decoded = std.json.decode(User, "{\"name\":\"Mira\",\"role\":\"Admin\",\"score\":255}") show(choose decoded { Ok(user) => user.name, Err(problem) => problem })

files.src/main.niv: shape Event { id: Int } define load() gives Result<Int, String> needs FileRead { keep opened = std.files.open_read("events.ndjson") or give using file = opened { keep event = std.json.read_next_as(Event, file, 64) or give give ok((event ?? Event(0)).id) } } show(load())
